callees.name: LanguageHandler.function_spans
callees.signature: function_spans(proj_dir: str, filepath: str) -> list[tuple[str, int, int]] | None
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a path to an existing project root directory. filepath is a path to a readable source file.
callees.post_condition: Returns a list of (name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples representing function definitions found in the file by the codegraph index, with start_idx and end_idx as 0-based inclusive line indices. Returns None when the codegraph index does not cover this file.
